_note: Source: UB College Student Discipline Policy, document SAEP M, Revision No. 4 (revision date 03/17/2026, approved 03/25/2026), sections FIRST/SECOND/THIRD DEGREE OFFENSES and their INTERVENTIONS. 'section' gives the list and the item number as printed in the policy. Offense names are short labels written for the dropdown; the policy's own wording is in handbook/discipline-policy.txt. Ids (cdb-4-N-M) are kept from the earlier Revision No. 7 list so existing complaints still match: 4-1 = First Degree, 4-3 = Second Degree, 4-5 = Third Degree, M = the item number. Press 'Sync offense list' on the SAEP All cases page after changing this file.
